summary: The compliance review of the KYCFast: Video KYC and Biometric Onboarding product identified several gaps against the RBI guidelines. A high-risk issue was found under [DLD2025:13(iii)] as IDFlow stores borrowers' fingerprint scans on its servers, which is not permitted unless allowed under extant statutory guidelines. A medium-risk issue was identified under [DLD2025:13(i)] as IDFlow retains full copies of borrowers' bank statements and salary slips indefinitely after loan approval. A high-risk issue was also found under [DLD2025:13(ii)] as neither Narmada Bank nor IDFlow has a data retention or deletion policy, and data is kept indefinitely, violating the requirement for clear policy guidelines. Additionally, a high-risk issue was identified under [DLD2025:13(iii)] as the product does not explicitly mention whether biometric data is stored or collected, creating a potential compliance gap.
